description.narrative: Stöd till tre regionala organisationer som ger bidrag inom internet governance till olika aktörer. Bidragen är små och fokuserade på kapacitetsutveckling.
Support to three regional organisations who provides support to actors within internet governance. The support is done through small grants and capacity development.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Sida assess that Seed Alliance has made progress towards the intended outcome, and that they have been able to showcase progress with a number of examples. The different regional initiatives within Seed Alliance have managed to find interesting technologies and strengthen the developers to magnify the progress as well as develop the network around the developer. Sida collaboration with Seed alliance should be seen as a collaboration with the tech community and has been very positive both to extend the relation with new actors as well as being a win-win situation from a learning perspective. Sida has built the competence around challenge funds.
Sida also had the intension to strengthen the organisation of Seed alliance, during the support the capacity. The collaboration between the different regional entities has promoted the development of the African entity. There was no capacity for doing challenge funds before the Swedish support and through the program much of the knowledge from the Asian and the Latin America program has been transferred to African program. Despite challenges such as language barriers, AFRINIC has been quite successful in reaching out to different communities. The next step is to join a European network. That will be made possible through continued funding from IDRC and new funding from ISOC.
There is still work to done in developing the platforms for challenge funds. One key issue is the challenge to capture and aggregate results within challenge funds in general and in Seed Alliance specifically. The method itself, to support several different and in this case small projects in different areas and regions, is complex. Other areas for further attention should be level of support, evaluations of proposals, technical support, and scaling up.
